entries.game: Call of Duty - Black Ops III
entries.name: VM ScriptFunctionCall handler
entries.evidence: SHA256-identified ELF profile. Raw normal dispatch table RVA 0x1582D70, alias 51, stores RVA 0x773C80. Entry bytes match scoped IDA listing at B73C80. B73D18 writes child-thread type 0x14; B73D55..B73D73 aligns and loads the resolved function qword into the frame code position. Corroborates PS4 T7OP_Call ScriptFunctionCall selection. No live invocation in this analysis. IDA signature attempt resolved to enclosing B73B00 instead of this entry and was rejected; short exact entry prefix has 16 matches.
entries.description: Loader-resolved ordinary function call handler. The imported aligned operand must already be resolved; this RVA is not a generic builtin entrypoint.

entries.game: Call of Duty - Black Ops III
entries.name: VM ScriptMethodCall handler
entries.evidence: SHA256-identified ELF profile. Raw normal dispatch table RVA 0x1582D70, alias 323, stores RVA 0x774380. Entry bytes match scoped IDA B74380. B74397..B743A2 checks receiver value type 1; B74410 writes child-thread type 0x14; B74450 pops receiver; B7445C..B7447A aligns and loads the function qword. Corroborates PS4 T7OP_Call receiver selection. No live invocation. IDA AOB attempt at the requested address found no unique signature within 80 bytes.
entries.description: Loader-resolved receiver method call handler. Requires an engine object receiver and resolved function operand; receiver ownership and call ABI matter.

entries.game: Call of Duty - Black Ops III
entries.name: VM ScriptThreadCall handler
entries.evidence: SHA256-identified ELF profile. Raw normal dispatch table RVA 0x1582D70, alias 416, stores RVA 0x7748B0. Entry bytes match scoped IDA B748B0. B74933 writes root-thread type 0x11; B74973 reads argc, B74976..B7499A aligns and loads the function qword; B749A1 increments the instance thread counter. Corroborates PS4 T7OP_Call Threaded selection. IDA reported the entry AOB unique. No live invocation or cross-version signature validation in this analysis.
entries.description: Loader-resolved global thread call handler, distinct from ScriptThreadCallPointer and receiver threads.
